{{Short description|Italian physicist and mathematician (1929–2010)}}
{{about|the mathematician|the philologist, essayist, and poet|Fausto Cercignani}}
'''Carlo Cercignani''' (17 June 1939 in [[Teulada, Sardinia|Teulada]] &ndash; 7 January 2010 in [[Milan]]) was an Italian [[mathematician]] known for his work on the [[kinetic theory of gases|kinetic theory]] of gases. His contributions to the study of [[Boltzmann's equation]] include the proof of the [[H-theorem]] for [[polyatomic]] gases.<ref name=sone>{{cite journal|journal=Phys. Fluids|volume=23|year=2011|issue=3|doi= 10.1063/1.3558864|first=Y. |last=Sone|title=A Tribute to Carlo Cercignani (1939–2010)}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|journal=Nuovo Cimento C|
volume=033|issue=1 |pages=  1&ndash;2 |doi=10.1393/ncc/i2010-10588-x|first=G.|last= Frosali|title=Carlo Cercignani: In memoriam
|
year=2010|
bibcode=2010NCimC..33a...1F}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|mr=2264609 |
last=Villani|first=Cédric|author-link=Cédric Villani|title=Introduction for Carlo's special issue|journal=J. Stat. Phys.|volume= 124 |year=2006|issue=2&ndash;4|pages=271&ndash;273|doi=10.1007/s10955-006-9118-7|
bibcode=2006JSP...124..271V|
s2cid=121052646}}</ref>  The [[Cercignani conjecture]] is named after him.<ref>{{cite journal|mr=2765747|last1=Desvillettes|first1=L.|last2=Mouhot|first2=C|last3=Villani|first3=C.|title=Celebrating Cercignani's conjecture for the Boltzmann equation.|journal=Kinet. Relat. Models|volume=4|year=2011|issue=1|pages=277&ndash;294|arxiv=1009.4006|doi=10.3934/krm.2011.4.277|s2cid=45105494 }}</ref>

Cercignani's conjecture is "sometimes true and always almost true", as proved by the Fields medalist mathematician [[Cédric Villani]].

He is the author of several [[monograph]]s and more than 300 papers in kinetic theory, as well as of a biography of [[Boltzmann]]. Cercignani was member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]]<ref>[http://www.academie-sciences.fr/academie/membre/Cercignani_Carlo.htm French Academy of Sciences necrology] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120528235236/http://www.academie-sciences.fr/academie/membre/Cercignani_Carlo.htm |date=May 28, 2012 }}</ref> and of the [[Accademia dei Lincei]]. He received the [[Humboldt Prize]] in 1994.<ref name=sone/>
